features.title: Auto-Save Draft Functionality
features.description: Implement automatic saving of form inputs and text content at configurable intervals, with manual save option and visual indicator of last saved state

features.title: Dark/Light Theme Toggle
features.description: Add system preference detection and manual theme switching with persistent storage, CSS custom properties for colors, and smooth transition animations

features.title: Toast Notification System
features.description: Create reusable toast component with success, error, warning, and info variants, queue management, auto-dismiss, and customizable positioning

features.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Manager
features.description: Implement global and context-aware keyboard shortcuts for common actions with shortcut conflict detection and customizable keybindings

features.title: Accessibility Audit and ARIA
features.description: Conduct WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audit, add proper ARIA labels, improve focus management, and add skip navigation links throughout the application

features.title: PDF Report Export
features.description: Add PDF generation capability for project reports, accelerator steps, and business models with customizable templates and branding options

features.title: CSV Data Export
features.description: Implement CSV export for tabular data including tasks, projects, and financial data with column selection and encoding options

features.title: Advanced Project Search
features.description: Build full-text search across all projects with filters, sorting, and fuzzy matching using indexedDB capabilities and search highlighting

features.title: Bulk Task Operations
features.description: Add multi-select functionality for tasks with bulk actions including move, delete, tag, assign, and status change across all project views

features.title: Dashboard Customization
features.description: Enable drag-and-drop widget arrangement on dashboard with widget show/hide toggles and saved layout preferences per user

features.title: User Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Create step-by-step guided tour for new users covering key features, project creation, and accelerator process introduction with progress tracking

features.title: Performance Monitoring Dashboard
features.description: Implement client-side performance metrics tracking including load times, render performance, database query times, and memory usage visualization

features.title: Rich Text Editor Integration
features.description: Add WYSIWYG editor for long-form content in steps with markdown support, formatting toolbar, and image embedding capability

features.title: File Attachments Support
features.description: Implement file upload and storage for project attachments with IndexedDB storage, thumbnail preview, and file type validation

features.title: Project Template Library
features.description: Create pre-built accelerator templates for common startup types with customizable defaults and template sharing between users

features.title: AI Model Selection Interface
features.description: Add user interface for selecting different LLM models with cost estimation, capability comparison, and per-model credit pricing

features.title: LLM Response Caching
features.description: Implement intelligent caching of AI responses based on input similarity to reduce credit usage and improve response times for repeated queries

features.title: Scheduled Data Backup
features.description: Add automatic scheduled backups to localStorage with configurable intervals, restore from backup functionality, and backup version management

features.title: User Activity Analytics
features.description: Build analytics dashboard showing usage patterns, accelerator progress statistics, time spent per model, and productivity metrics visualization

features.title: Voice Input Support
features.description: Add speech-to-text integration for text inputs and form fields with language detection and microphone permission handling
